on_screen_text: बैंक [Bank], हिन्दी में सहायता उपलब्ध [Hindi help available], क्या तुम भी काम पे इंग्लिश वाले कस्टमर के सामने चुप हो जाती हो? [Do you also freeze in front of English customers at work?], English Seekho, Keep Learning, DISCLAIMER
summary: A bank employee struggles with speaking English to customers, leading to missed promotions. She downloads the English Seekho app, practicing with short videos and an AI coach.
